overall_summary: Data shows clear viewer preference for husband-wife relationship and domestic emotional realities (getting ~1.7k views), significantly outperforming generic shayari or family member spotlights which averaged under 300 views. Confidence is low due to small sample size, requiring a controlled exploration strategy leaning heavily into proven relationship themes.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,767 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,674 views) heavily outperformed everything else.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marital and modern relationship dynamics, communication gaps, and emotional distance.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 19 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or cryptic shayari titles; stick to grounded, conversational real-life observations.

weak_patterns.evidence: Individual videos on sisters, fathers, and brothers averaged between 19 and 142 views.
weak_patterns.action: Pause isolated family member segments unless tied directly to broader relationship or life friction.
